missions.title: Whole-Self Wellness Challenge
missions.story: A village fitness fair needs help. Learners assess how habits affect physical, emotional and social well-being, then guide teammates through a target-and-invasion game.
missions.focus: Interrelated wellness dimensions, healthy habits, physical activity benefits and target/invasion game concepts.

finalChallenge.title: Wellness Fair Finale
finalChallenge.description: Wellness Fair final: make a balanced daily routine and choose a safe target/invasion-game strategy. Demonstrate an age-appropriate movement skill if observed by the teacher.

steps.prompt: Wellness Fair Finale: build a balanced routine by categorizing these weekly practices.
items: Consistent bedtime with 8-9 hours of sleep
Staying up all night gaming before a sports tournament
Encouraging friends and resolving conflicts respectfully
Refusing all water during vigorous workouts

steps.prompt: Select the most effective target and invasion strategy:
items: Run through the thickest crowd of defenders without looking
Scan the field, pass to an open teammate, and cut into scoring space
Never pass to teammates under any circumstances
steps.success: Mission 1 complete! You earned the Whole-Self Wellness Badge!

checkpoints.title: Wellness Center
checkpoints.npcOpening: Hello! Welcome to Wellness Center. First read the lesson, then try our activity and answer the questions.
checkpoints.lesson: Wellness includes physical, mental/emotional and social aspects. Sleep, regular movement, respectful relationships and asking for support can affect more than one area. Learners should avoid judging others by appearance or making medical claims about classmates.

miniGame.name: Wellness Web
miniGame.instructions: Connect sleep, friendships, movement and asking for support to more than one wellness dimension.

steps.prompt: Wellness Web: connect each daily habit to its primary wellness dimension.
items: Getting 8-9 hours of consistent sleep
Maintaining respectful, supportive friendships
Practicing slow breathing when feeling overwhelmed
Participating in regular active games and exercise
Talking with a trusted teacher when stressed
steps.success: Excellent holistic understanding! All three dimensions support whole-self wellness.

questions.text: Which habit can support both physical and emotional wellness?
questions.explanation: Adequate rest supports physical functions and emotional regulation.
questions.feedback: Adequate rest supports physical functions and emotional regulation.

questions.text: Which example shows social well-being?
questions.explanation: Positive relationships are part of social health.
questions.feedback: Positive relationships are part of social health.

questions.text: A student feels overwhelmed by schoolwork. What is a constructive response?
options: Organize tasks and seek appropriate support
questions.explanation: Planning and support can help manage stress.
questions.feedback: Planning and support can help manage stress.

questions.text: Why is wellness described as interconnected?
options: One habit may affect several dimensions
questions.explanation: Physical, emotional and social experiences can influence one another.
questions.feedback: Physical, emotional and social experiences can influence one another.

questions.text: Which is a realistic goal for a healthier routine?
options: Move regularly and keep a consistent sleep schedule
Do one intense workout and never repeat
questions.explanation: Sustainable habits can support health over time.
questions.feedback: Sustainable habits can support health over time.

checkpoints.title: Target and Invasion Field
checkpoints.npcOpening: Hello! Welcome to Target and Invasion Field. First read the lesson, then try our activity and answer the questions.
checkpoints.lesson: Target games focus on sending an object toward a goal; invasion games involve advancing into an opposing area while keeping possession and defending space. Scan the field, communicate, make safe passes and use balanced movements.

miniGame.name: Tactics Board
miniGame.instructions: Place players into open passing lanes and choose a suitable throw toward a target.

steps.prompt: In an invasion game, why is moving into open space important?
items: It makes passing and teamwork unnecessary
It creates a safe passing lane to receive the ball
It prevents defenders from following rules
steps.success: Tactical awareness! Open space unlocks scoring plays.

steps.prompt: Tactics Board: classify these skills into Target Game Skill vs Invasion Game Tactic.
items: Aiming accurately toward a stationary goal
Defending open space against moving attackers
Throwing a beanbag into a target ring
Cutting into an open lane to receive a pass
steps.success: Great tactical distinction between target and invasion games!

questions.text: What is a main goal in a target game?
questions.explanation: Target games emphasize accuracy toward a goal.
questions.feedback: Target games emphasize accuracy toward a goal.

questions.text: In an invasion game, why is moving into open space useful?
options: It creates a possible passing option
questions.explanation: Open space can provide a safer or more effective passing lane.
questions.feedback: Open space can provide a safer or more effective passing lane.

questions.text: What should a defender watch during play?
options: Ball, player positions and safe space
questions.explanation: Awareness helps a defender respond effectively.
questions.feedback: Awareness helps a defender respond effectively.

questions.text: Which action shows safe game strategy?
options: Run into crowded space on purpose
questions.explanation: Communication promotes coordination and safety.
questions.feedback: Communication promotes coordination and safety.

questions.text: Which skill especially supports an accurate throw?
questions.explanation: Coordination helps direct a throw toward its target.
questions.feedback: Coordination helps direct a throw toward its target.

checkpoints.title: Balance Trail
checkpoints.npcOpening: Hello! Welcome to Balance Trail. First read the lesson, then try our activity and answer the questions.
checkpoints.lesson: Healthy routines combine movement, rest, hydration and supportive relationships. During team games, using space, respecting rules and adapting activities to skill levels can help all learners participate.

miniGame.name: Balance Planner
miniGame.instructions: Select weekly habits and a legal passing route while avoiding overtraining and unsafe play.

steps.prompt: Balance Planner: sort the practices into Balanced Routine vs Unsafe / Overtraining.
items: Active play with planned hydration and rest breaks
Continuing to play through sharp pain or exhaustion
Offering an appropriate role to an excluded classmate
Skipping meals and sleep to practice more
steps.success: Well done! Recognizing limits and staying inclusive protects health.

questions.text: Which habit should accompany regular physical activity?
questions.explanation: Rest and hydration help support safe physical activity.
questions.feedback: Rest and hydration help support safe physical activity.

questions.text: A classmate is repeatedly left out of games. What should the team do?
options: Offer an appropriate role and encourage participation
questions.explanation: Inclusive behavior supports social well-being.
questions.feedback: Inclusive behavior supports social well-being.

questions.text: A teammate is open near the goal. Which choice may support the play?
options: Make a controlled pass when safe
questions.explanation: A controlled pass to an open teammate can improve the play.
questions.feedback: A controlled pass to an open teammate can improve the play.

questions.text: When a player becomes exhausted, what is a safe response?
options: Take an appropriate break and tell an adult if unwell
questions.explanation: Recognizing limits and resting supports safe activity.
questions.feedback: Recognizing limits and resting supports safe activity.

questions.text: Which plan addresses physical and social wellness?
options: Join inclusive active games with appropriate rest
Make everyone use the same skill level
questions.explanation: Activity plus positive interactions supports multiple wellness dimensions.
questions.feedback: Activity plus positive interactions supports multiple wellness dimensions.

missions.title: Healthy Decisions and Game Strategy
missions.story: Learners prepare a Respect and Fair-Play Week. They practice finding trustworthy health information, responding respectfully to sensitive questions and making safe decisions in different games.
missions.focus: Age-appropriate adolescent/reproductive health and family support; striking/fielding and net/wall game tactics.

finalChallenge.title: Respect and Strategy Week Finale
finalChallenge.description: Respect and Strategy Week final: evaluate one sensitive-information scenario and solve two game-strategy problems; demonstrate a controlled movement task if facilities permit.

steps.prompt: Evaluating Health Information: Which source provides the most reliable reproductive and puberty health guidance?
items: Viral social media gossip comments
Qualified healthcare professionals, registered school nurses, and trusted guardians
Anonymous chat forum participants

steps.prompt: Game Decision Solving: sort these choices into Fair-Play Decision vs Foul / Unfair Play.
items: Accepting referee calls respectfully and shaking hands after the match
Deliberately tripping an opponent during an open drive
Using legal court angles to return difficult shots
Taunting and mocking someone after an error
steps.success: Mission 2 complete! You earned the Respect and Strategy Badge!

checkpoints.title: Trusted Choices Clinic
checkpoints.npcOpening: Hello! Welcome to Trusted Choices Clinic. First read the lesson, then try our activity and answer the questions.
checkpoints.lesson: As young people develop, accurate information, respect, personal boundaries and trusted adult support are important. Reproductive health is part of overall health. Questions about puberty, personal safety and pregnancy prevention should be discussed in age-appropriate ways with qualified adults or health professionals; rumors are unreliable.

miniGame.name: Trust the Source
miniGame.instructions: Classify messages from health professionals, caregivers, advertisements and anonymous rumors by reliability.

steps.prompt: Trust the Source: classify these health information sources by reliability.
items: Guidance from a qualified school nurse or doctor
Anonymous viral rumors on a video platform
Factual advice from a supportive parent or guardian
A stranger selling secret quick-growth products online
steps.success: Smart thinking! Evidence-based sources and trusted adults protect your well-being.

questions.text: A learner has a sensitive health question. Who is an appropriate source?
options: A trusted adult or qualified health professional
Any stranger in a game chat
questions.explanation: Qualified adults and professionals provide more reliable, age-appropriate guidance.
questions.feedback: Qualified adults and professionals provide more reliable, age-appropriate guidance.

questions.text: Why are personal boundaries important?
options: They help protect dignity and safety
questions.explanation: Respect for boundaries supports safer relationships.
questions.feedback: Respect for boundaries supports safer relationships.

questions.text: A classmate spreads false information about puberty. What is a reasonable response?
options: Check trusted health information and avoid spreading rumors
questions.explanation: Verification reduces the spread of harmful misinformation.
questions.feedback: Verification reduces the spread of harmful misinformation.

questions.text: What is one helpful role of a trusted family member?
options: Forcing someone to share private details publicly
questions.explanation: Supportive family members can help during adolescence.
questions.feedback: Supportive family members can help during adolescence.

questions.text: Which action best supports responsible adolescent decisions?
options: Considering consequences and seeking reliable guidance
questions.explanation: Thoughtful, well-informed decisions support safety.
questions.feedback: Thoughtful, well-informed decisions support safety.

checkpoints.title: Strategy Games Court
checkpoints.npcOpening: Hello! Welcome to Strategy Games Court. First read the lesson, then try our activity and answer the questions.
checkpoints.lesson: In striking/fielding games, players send the ball into field space while opponents retrieve it. In net/wall games, players send and return an object legally. Both require positioning, controlled movement, communication and rules.

miniGame.name: Tactics Switch
miniGame.instructions: Compare a field diagram with a net/wall diagram; select legal open areas and correct ready positions.

steps.prompt: When fielders crowd one side of the play area, where should a striker send the ball?
items: Directly into the crowd of fielders
Toward clear open space on the opposite side
Beyond a forbidden boundary
steps.success: Great striking strategy! Exploiting legal open space is key.

steps.prompt: After a controlled return over the net, what should a player do immediately?
items: Celebrate before watching the play
Recover a balanced ready position to cover open space
Drop equipment and walk off
steps.success: Court recovery keeps you ready for the next shot.

questions.text: When fielders crowd one side, where could a striker send the ball?
options: Toward clear space on the opposite side
Anywhere with no regard for rules
questions.explanation: Using legal open space can be an effective striking tactic.
questions.feedback: Using legal open space can be an effective striking tactic.

questions.text: Which is a useful defensive position in a net/wall game?
options: Staying ready to cover reachable open space
questions.explanation: A balanced ready position helps cover the court.
questions.feedback: A balanced ready position helps cover the court.

questions.text: After a controlled return, what should a player do?
questions.explanation: Recovery prepares the player for the next exchange.
questions.feedback: Recovery prepares the player for the next exchange.

questions.text: Why should teammates call for a ball?
options: To reduce confusion over who receives it
questions.explanation: Clear communication supports coordinated safe play.
questions.feedback: Clear communication supports coordinated safe play.

questions.text: Which statement shows good sportsmanship?
questions.explanation: Fair play requires respect and agreed rules.
questions.feedback: Fair play requires respect and agreed rules.

checkpoints.title: Decision Junction
checkpoints.npcOpening: Hello! Welcome to Decision Junction. First read the lesson, then try our activity and answer the questions.
checkpoints.lesson: Responsible choices consider accurate information, consent and boundaries, and the safety of others. A good player also checks rules, adapts to game conditions and chooses controlled movements.

miniGame.name: Two-Path Challenge
miniGame.instructions: Answer a respectful communication scenario, then select a useful game tactic from a court image.

steps.prompt: A student is pressured in a group chat to share private health details. What is safest?
items: Post private details to avoid criticism
Keep personal boundaries and consult a trusted adult privately
Ask classmates to vote on it publicly
steps.success: Respecting boundaries and seeking trusted guidance protects dignity and safety.

steps.prompt: Two-Path Challenge: classify these actions as Responsible Decision vs Risky Choice.
items: Seeking reliable guidance from health professionals
Spreading unverified rumors on social media
Calling clearly to communicate who will catch a ball
Body-checking another player during games
steps.success: Clear judgment in both health decisions and game strategy!

questions.text: A student is pressured to share a private health concern in a group chat. What is safest?
options: Ask classmates to vote on it
Keep privacy and talk with a trusted adult privately
questions.explanation: Sensitive concerns should be handled respectfully with appropriate support.
questions.feedback: Sensitive concerns should be handled respectfully with appropriate support.

questions.text: A friend claims a viral video is always correct about health. What should you do?
options: Compare its claims with reliable health guidance
questions.explanation: Reliable sources matter more than popularity.
questions.feedback: Reliable sources matter more than popularity.

questions.text: In a striking game, what should influence the shot choice?
options: The color of the uniform only
Open legal space and defender positions
questions.explanation: Players consider space and opposing positions when choosing a tactic.
questions.feedback: Players consider space and opposing positions when choosing a tactic.

questions.text: In a net/wall match, what is an effective response to a short return?
options: Move safely toward the ball and make a controlled return
questions.explanation: Safe movement and controlled return respond to the play.
questions.feedback: Safe movement and controlled return respond to the play.

questions.text: Which pair shows responsible decisions in both settings?
options: Stay silent when threatened and play unsafely
Seek reliable guidance and follow safe game rules
questions.explanation: Both choices prioritize evidence, respect and safety.
questions.feedback: Both choices prioritize evidence, respect and safety.

missions.title: Healthy Community, Active Environment
missions.story: The village prepares for a Community Health Walk. Learners identify ways to prevent illness, protect shared spaces and choose safe rhythmic and outdoor activities.
missions.focus: Communicable disease prevention, sanitation and One Health; rhythm, active transportation, outdoor activity and leadership.

finalChallenge.title: Community Health Walk Finale
finalChallenge.description: Community Health Walk finale: diagnose a hygiene issue, explain a One Health action and lead a safe rhythmic warm-up or short walk with teacher observation where possible.

steps.prompt: One Health Community Walk: classify these actions for environmental and personal health.
items: Organizing community cleanups to eliminate stagnant mosquito breeding sites
Leaving animal waste unmanaged near local water wells
Using marked pedestrian sidewalks and crosswalks during active walks
Washing hands thoroughly with soap after outdoor activities

steps.prompt: During a community walk in hot weather, what is the best leadership action?
items: Force participants to run as fast as possible without drinking water
Provide water hydration stations, shaded rest breaks, and monitor participants for heat exhaustion
Cancel all safety rules
steps.success: Mission 3 complete! You earned the Healthy Community Badge!

checkpoints.title: Community Health Watch
checkpoints.npcOpening: Hello! Welcome to Community Health Watch. First read the lesson, then try our activity and answer the questions.
checkpoints.lesson: Communicable illnesses may spread between people through different routes depending on the illness. Handwashing, appropriate respiratory hygiene, clean water and reliable immunization guidance reduce some health risks. One Health connects human, animal and environmental well-being.

miniGame.name: Break the Chain
miniGame.instructions: Place handwashing, safe food handling, clean water and ventilation cards at relevant prevention spots in a village scene.

steps.prompt: Break the Chain: classify these practices into Infection Prevention vs Health Risk.
items: Washing hands properly with clean water and soap
Drinking untreated water from an unknown source
Covering sneezes and practicing respiratory hygiene
Leaving stagnant water containers uncovered
steps.success: Great prevention mindset! Clean habits protect the entire community.

questions.text: Which habit helps reduce the spread of many infections?
questions.explanation: Proper handwashing reduces spread of many microbes.
questions.feedback: Proper handwashing reduces spread of many microbes.

questions.text: Why is safe drinking water important?
options: It changes every virus into air
It helps prevent some waterborne illnesses
questions.explanation: Clean water lowers risk from waterborne pathogens.
questions.feedback: Clean water lowers risk from waterborne pathogens.

questions.text: What does One Health emphasize?
options: Connections among people, animals and the environment
questions.explanation: One Health considers linked human, animal and environmental health.
questions.feedback: One Health considers linked human, animal and environmental health.

questions.text: Which is a reliable source for vaccine questions?
options: A rumor from a game lobby
A health professional or official public-health guidance
questions.explanation: Qualified professionals and public-health sources provide reliable guidance.
questions.feedback: Qualified professionals and public-health sources provide reliable guidance.

questions.text: A classmate returns after an illness. What is respectful behavior?
options: Follow school health guidance and treat them kindly
questions.explanation: Prevention should be paired with respect for others.
questions.feedback: Prevention should be paired with respect for others.

checkpoints.title: Active Nature Trail
checkpoints.npcOpening: Hello! Welcome to Active Nature Trail. First read the lesson, then try our activity and answer the questions.
checkpoints.lesson: Outdoor recreation and active transportation can provide regular movement and enjoyment while supporting environmental awareness. Rhythmic activities combine beats, patterns and movement levels. Choose safe paths, check conditions and respect shared spaces.

miniGame.name: Trail Planner
miniGame.instructions: Choose a safe walking route and tap or arrange a four-count rhythmic warm-up; teacher may observe movement.

steps.prompt: Trail Planner: tap the outdoor walking event steps in safe sequence.
items: Check weather, route conditions and safety rules
Lead a gentle warm-up with safe personal spacing
Walk along designated marked paths and stay hydrated
Dispose of all litter in proper trash bins
steps.success: Safe outdoor recreation and stewardship achieved!

steps.prompt: Which activity is a primary example of active transportation?
items: Riding in a passenger vehicle
Walking or cycling to school safely
Watching a running video at home
steps.success: Active transportation builds daily physical fitness.

questions.text: Which activity is an example of active transportation?
options: Walking to a nearby safe destination
questions.explanation: Walking uses physical movement to travel.
questions.feedback: Walking uses physical movement to travel.

questions.text: Before an outdoor activity, what should a leader check?
questions.explanation: Conditions affect safe participation outdoors.
questions.feedback: Conditions affect safe participation outdoors.

questions.text: What does following a rhythmic count help develop?
questions.explanation: Rhythm improves the timing of coordinated movement.
questions.feedback: Rhythm improves the timing of coordinated movement.

questions.text: Which action respects the environment during a walk?
options: Using bins and staying on safe marked paths
questions.explanation: Responsible recreation protects shared environments.
questions.feedback: Responsible recreation protects shared environments.

questions.text: Which leader action best protects participants?
options: Demonstrating moves clearly and checking safe spacing
questions.explanation: Clear instruction and safe space support group activity.
questions.feedback: Clear instruction and safe space support group activity.

checkpoints.title: Healthy Village Action Center
checkpoints.npcOpening: Hello! Welcome to Healthy Village Action Center. First read the lesson, then try our activity and answer the questions.
checkpoints.lesson: A healthy community plan can combine sanitation, responsible animal care, environmental protection and active lifestyles. Claims should be based on evidence and appropriate public guidance. Children can report problems and contribute through safe, supervised activities.

miniGame.name: Community Puzzle
miniGame.instructions: Match stagnant littered water, poor handwashing access and unsafe footpaths to appropriate community actions.

steps.prompt: Community Puzzle: sort these actions into One Health Action vs Harmful Practice.
items: Safe waste management and clean shared spaces
Dumping plastic garbage into streams and rivers
Responsible animal care and sanitation
Ignoring handwashing supply shortages in school
steps.success: One Health champion! Human, animal, and environmental wellness are linked.

questions.text: A school notices that handwashing supplies are missing. What is a useful response?
options: Report the shortage and improve access to supplies
questions.explanation: Supplies support appropriate hand hygiene.
questions.feedback: Supplies support appropriate hand hygiene.

questions.text: Why should community health decisions use evidence?
options: Evidence helps compare whether an action is appropriate
questions.explanation: Reliable information helps plan sound health responses.
questions.feedback: Reliable information helps plan sound health responses.

questions.text: Which group of actions reflects One Health?
options: Caring only for human fitness and ignoring waste
Feeding animals without cleaning shared spaces
Removing all trees from a park
Safe waste management, responsible animal care and clean shared spaces
questions.explanation: These choices consider human, animal and environmental connections.
questions.feedback: These choices consider human, animal and environmental connections.

questions.text: A group plans a walking event in very hot weather. What is a safer choice?
options: Adjust timing, offer water and observe participants
questions.explanation: Appropriate heat precautions help reduce risk.
questions.feedback: Appropriate heat precautions help reduce risk.

questions.text: Which project combines health and PE most effectively?
options: Remove sanitation signs and cancel safe exercise
Organize a supervised clean-up and safe community walk
questions.explanation: A safe clean-up and walk join environmental health and physical activity.
questions.feedback: A safe clean-up and walk join environmental health and physical activity.
